contracts: VDP_BuildTileRowCommandTables writes 32 longword entries to each promoted table.
The selected table at 0x00FF8680 and its mirror at 0x00FF8700 receive identical commands.
The alternate table at 0x00FF8780 receives the other plane sequence, with C000/E000 assignment controlled by VDP_TILE_PLANE_ORDER.
VDP_WriteTileWord and camera viewport/refill code consume entries from the selected table.
evidence: Exact table-base/indexing instructions in VDP_WriteTileWord and camera refill paths
Whole-ROM context queries for all three table bases
limitations: The selected/alternate labels describe the runtime plane-order relationship and do not hard-code C000 or E000 ownership.
The selected mirror has no currently exported consumer beyond its builder write path.
conclusion: The generated Unknown_00FF8680, Unknown_00FF8700, and Unknown_00FF8780 identities are replaced by stable VDP tile-row command-table names while preserving the dynamic plane-order contract.
